about: The Workbench icons of the Mojotron drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/mojotron.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: the hero in the arena, firing at a robot) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/mojotron.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Mojotron-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Mojotron.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Mojotron.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the other text files; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
